purpose: Shocks and the one plain sentence each reads as. The dashboard writes it with shockWords and effectWords in frontend/src/arms.tsx, and the translate endpoint returns the same sentence as its words, written by shock_words and effect_words in python/loveworld/translate.py. A frontend test and a Python test both require every sentence here, and the Python test also requires the catalog below to be the one the API serves, so the two wordings cannot drift apart. To change a sentence on purpose, change both functions and the sentence here together.

catalog.label: Job loss
catalog.blurb: One partner loses their job: a stress jump on the start day, then extra daily stress until the end day.

catalog.label: Financial crisis
catalog.blurb: Money trouble for the household: both partners carry extra daily stress between the start and end days.

catalog.label: Temptation
catalog.blurb: One partner keeps meeting attractive alternatives: a higher daily chance of an outside encounter.

catalog.label: Intimacy mismatch
catalog.blurb: One partner's wish for closeness shifts; the gap drags on affect and the partner wanting more may store disappointment.

catalog.label: Daily texts
catalog.blurb: One partner sends affection every day: the other stores a small positive memory and a lift in affect.

catalog.label: Anniversary
catalog.blurb: On the start day and every 365 days after, both partners store a strong positive memory and trust rises.

catalog.label: Date nights
catalog.blurb: Every seventh day between the start and end days, both partners store a positive memory.

catalog.label: Trait shift
catalog.blurb: One partner's named trait moves by the magnitude on the start day (clamped to 0 to 1).
